name: Joash
summary: A son of Ahaziah who was hidden as a child in the LORD's house and crowned king of Judah at seven. He did right while Jehoiada the priest taught him, but later turned away and had Jehoiada's son killed.

key_moments.title: Hidden in the Temple
key_moments.description: When Athaliah killed the royal family, Jehosheba, sister of King Ahaziah, stole young Joash away with his nurse. He stayed hidden in the LORD's house for six years.

key_moments.title: Crowned at Seven
key_moments.description: Jehoiada the priest brought out the king's son, crowned and anointed him, and the people clapped. Joash was only seven when he became king.

key_moments.title: Repairing the LORD's House
key_moments.description: When the priests left the temple unrepaired, Joash had the money gathered in a chest by the altar. It was paid out to carpenters, builders and masons to mend the house.

key_moments.title: Gold for Hazael
key_moments.description: When Hazael king of Syria set out against Jerusalem, Joash sent him all the holy things and the gold from the temple and the palace. Then Hazael went away.

key_moments.title: Forgetting Jehoiada's Kindness
key_moments.description: After Jehoiada died, Joash listened to the princes of Judah, and the people turned to idols. When Jehoiada's son Zechariah warned them, he was stoned at the king's command, and later Joash's own servants killed him in his bed.
